modern: Consider where each thing has come from, and what it consists of, and what it changes into, and what kind of thing it will be when it has changed, and that it will suffer no harm.
original: Consider whence each thing is come, and of what it consists, and into what it changes, and what kind of a thing it will be when it has changed, and that it will sustain no harm.
